name: staging-review
description: Pre-client review gate for Hydra sites: before a staging or dev link goes to a client, reviews every page against the client's HBIS brief and what they've been told since — copy, brief accuracy, design, 375px mobile overflow, the two required sidebar menus, and whether the lead forms can send. Sites that fail get a full fix list on the Hydra Production Tracker with the Viber @-mentioned, move to Viber - Changes, and the Viber gets a short Slack DM. Client messages are drafts only. Needs the Slack and Asana connectors, a browser tool, and bash with curl and python3.
